name: Joachim Streit - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: REPORT on the draft Council decision on amendment of the EIB's Statute
part_text:
The European Investment Bank wants to change its own rulebook. Right now the bank can only lend up to 2.5 times its own funds. The bank wants to scrap that fixed limit and let its governors set the level by unanimous vote instead. Parliament agrees with the change. The bank says the current cap holds back its 2024–2027 plans. Parliament also says the bank must keep strong risk controls and stay transparent.

- The fixed 2.5-times lending cap would go; the bank's governors would set the limit unanimously instead.
- This affects the European Investment Bank, its borrowers and the member states that guarantee it.
- Parliament has approved the change; the Council of member states must now decide, unanimously.
